comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a damper; pr-1243 greases a loader pivot through a pressure-sensitive push-on coupler.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate aligns a hex key, unlocks and rotates a collar, relocks it, and evaluates impacts. pr-1243 seats and continuously holds a coupler square against push-off force while the other arm repeatedly pumps a lever, then removes and stows the coupler.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe repeatable stops and low post-lock drift. pr-1243 requires four valid pump shots while sealed, no leak in later versions, the coupler returned to its cup, and arms returned.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual stabilization under force, but the grease task tests sustained sealing plus repeated pumping; it does not test parameter adjustment, dynamic stopping, or setting retention.
